# V STAR Numerology & Astrology

> Authentic Vedic astrology and sacred Chaldean and Pythagorean numerology consultation platform, personalized birth chart ephemeris calculations, and cosmic life-path readings.

V STAR Numerology & Astrology harmonizes celestial planetary degrees and ancient number vibrations to provide accurate life-path, destiny, career, business, marriage, relationship compatibility, health, and vasthu consultations.

## Services Offered

- **Full Astrology & Numerology**: Comprehensive natal chart Kundli generation, planetary transits, Chaldean name compound analysis, and personalized remedy consultation.
- **Name Numerology & Correction**: Scientific name spelling alignment based on Cheiro and Chaldean vibration frequencies.
- **Business Numerology**: Brand, company name, and launch date alignment for financial prosperity and enterprise expansion.
- **Relationship & Marriage Compatibility**: Synastry Kundli matching, Porutham analysis, and planetary balance.
- **Career, Wealth & Gemstone**: Identifying fortunate vocational cycles, wealth houses, and authentic gemstone recommendations.
- **Vasthu & Space Energy Consultation**: Harmonizing physical living and commercial spaces with sacred cardinal directions.
- **Health Astrology**: Identifying planetary sensitivities and constitutional Ayurvedic balance.

## Core Features & Engines

- **Cosmic Snapshot Engine**: Instant browser-side calculation of Western and Vedic Sun Signs, Life Path numbers, and Destiny vibrations with full high-resolution PDF download.
- **Sacred Remedy & Ratna Recommender**: Personalized Vedic gemstone (Ratna), Mukhi Rudraksha, and Yantra recommendation engine based on Life Path Graha, Birth Rashi, and Harmonic Planetary Synergy.
- **Online Booking System**: Real-time consultation requests with encrypted Excel persistence and automatic confirmation emails.
- **Global Place of Birth Lookup**: Built-in coordinates and timezone resolution for accurate birth chart alignment.

## API & Endpoints

- `GET /api/status`: Platform health check, runtime diagnostics, and SMTP status.
- `POST /api/appointments`: Consultation appointment submission endpoint.
- `GET /.well-known/ard.json`: Autonomous Resource Discovery (ARD) agent manifest.
